Based on the results of the five highest similarity value data, the objects suitable for the Sequence Diagram are as follows: user, content creator, scenery app, home page, content page, profile page, notifications page, register page, authentication server, login page.

articleTitle: Implementation of Artificial Neural Network for Real-Time Blood Pressure Estimation using ECG Signal
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Computer Science and Informatics (EECSI)
abstract: Hypertension is one of the serious health problems because patients will realize when the disease becomes more severe or complications arise. Many studies have used a combination of electrocardiogram (ECG) signals and photoplethysmography (PPG) signals with various methods. Therefore, it is inefficient because it requires more sources of information that requires more sensors and time consuming. To solve this problem, we proposed real time blood pressure (BP) estimation using ECG signal and age based on Artificial Neural Network (ANN). ECG signal is extracted using AD8232 module and processed using Arduino Nano. Then, the features are selected using curve fitting and used for model training. A total of 56 samples were taken from healthy subjects aged 19-58 years. The results show high correlation between blood pressure and ECG signal, which is shown in high coefficient correlation. Our method shows promising results with Mean Absolute Error (MAE) values on training performances of 2.4 mmHg for systolic blood pressure (SBP) and 2.2 mmHg for diastolic blood pressure (DBP). The MAE values for SBP and DBP prediction using 15 separated test data are 2.8 mmHg and 2.9 mmHg, respectively. Experimental results show that our proposed method can estimate blood BP in real time with good accuracy.

articleTitle: The Effect of Short Video Advertising on Online Shopping Using Pay-Later Based on Online Customer Experience
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Computer Science and Informatics (EECSI)
abstract: This research investigates the impact of short video advertising on pay-later online shopping by examining the role of Online Customer Experience (OCE) and its relation to perceived benefits, perceived risks, trust propensity, perceived ease of use, and perceived usefulness. The study reveals that while perceived benefits, perceived risks, and trust propensity do not significantly influence OCE, it plays a crucial role in shaping customer satisfaction and re-purchase intentions. Additionally, perceived ease of use and perceived usefulness significantly impact OCE, emphasizing the importance of user-friendly platforms and highlighting their usefulness in creating a positive online shopping experience. These findings offer valuable insights for marketers to optimize OCE, enhance customer satisfaction, and drive future purchases.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study On Image Compression in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Computer Science and Informatics (EECSI)
abstract: Cloud computing is a computing model that offers integrated ICT infrastructure, for example, virtual resources, including processing activities, storage, software, and services, accessible through an Internet network. These resources are distributed and can be accessed from any device and location as needed. The use of cloud computing has been increasing, particularly for image storage, to alleviate the storage burden on physical media. Therefore, this research aims to compare different image compression techniques, namely Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT), Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT), Singular Value Decomposition (SVD), and Karhunen-Loève Transform (KLT), within the context of cloud computing.The study involves comparing the effectiveness of these four methods based on the level of compression achieved, processing speed during compression, and the similarity between the compressed and original images. Six sample images are utilized for testing purposes. The results indicate that the DWT method outperforms the SVD, KLT, and DCT methods in terms of file compression size, achieving an average compression rate of 12% compared to the original file. Additionally, the DWT method exhibits an average compression speed of 4.31 seconds and a grayscale similarity score of 0.96 with the original image. However, in terms of color scale similarity, the SVD method achieves a higher score of 13.1 compared to the DWT method.

articleTitle: Region-Based Convolutional Neural Network and Tesseract Optical Character Recognition for Recognising Entity Relationship Diagram
publicationTitle: 2023 10th International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Computer Science and Informatics (EECSI)
abstract: Object detection is a common technique nowadays and is utilised in many fields such as license plate detector, obstacle detector, and many others. However, most of the efforts are found to only focus on detecting objects of a certain class and are not suitable for the detection of diagrammatic contents. Object detection for diagrammatic contents has high demand at workplaces and educational institutions. It is different from other object detection as most diagrammatic contents are in grayscale or binary. Other than that, most object detector also only classifies the object to their class and is not capable of detecting their specific name. Hence, this work proposes a novel object detector based on region-based Convolutional Neural Network (R-CNN) for Entity Relationship Diagram (ERD) object detection which will also give the relationship of the ERD as the result. The framework consists of three main processes starting by the input image being pre-processed and then object detection on the image is carried out. The result of the object detection is then pre-processed again to be passed to the name detection by optical character recognition (OCR) and then the OCR result is post-processed to obtain a more accurate outcome. The final output is expressed in the relationship of the entities and an image with the detection labelled. The evaluation measurement used is stratified cross-validation where the training-testing percentage is 80% training and 20% testing. The proposed object detector managed to obtain satisfactory average accuracy of 81.92% using a low-resolution image dataset to train.
